title: GovernanceEventReceptor
description: Identifies the receptor that receives governance events. The framework reference and accepted event types define the governance contract surface — which framework instance is listening for which governance signals. Source: ITIP Meta-Governance Framework; GSM Receptor semantics.

frameworkRef.description: URI reference identifying the governance framework this receptor listens for (e.g., 'gsmarc://frameworks/gdpr/v1'). Defines WHICH governance domain this port serves. Identity-bound: receptors of the same Definition always listen for the same framework. Source: ITIP framework catalog.
